subject: HEAVY RELEASE compute + DELTA14 READY: TGP2 buffer table ce462be8; release+ASan real corpus PASS
body:
HEAVY RELEASE compute. DELTA14 complete for lowering's L2 buffer-table contract.

HEADER: metal/tegu/pipeline_format.h is byte-identical to proposed-header-buftable, sha256 ce462be8cf147750b25b2a475f08f2141c6dd8af6bb4e74f4d2e5a6189358df6 (MAX_BUFFERS31, FAU8, TABLE_BUFFER3, FLAG8, FAU272, record16, w19 mask, buffer_table_mask).

BRIDGE: nord2_metal_bridge.c 24011dbcba9d0d244709aba39b828051d3bf22fb21590160824a6163c14a4181. Descriptor buffer bindings0..30; arrays31. For w19 extensions, writes 16-byte {va+offset,bytes,0} records into a 496-byte table embedded at command offset40960 (command lifetime; no extra transport handle); writes {table_va,496,0} at FAU byte272 and raises FAU count to cover it; validates all ext bindings/flag/mask before submit; retains referenced buffers. Code handle is best-effort last.

PLANNER: air_bridge.rs f9db0bf0b95ef8bbff5104febf2036c96035944cf044d7c0c4487fc8e20a1841 allows native buffer bindings0..30; air_bridge.h 180eabf permits MAX_BUFFERS31 and asserts it fits existing 32-record TDG2 capacity. TDG2 size remains 32*192; no wire resize.

TESTS: python3 workers/compute/check_compute_v2.py from gpu/: pipeline format, synthetic bridge (ext8/9/10 table), and real corpus package all PASS in release AND one ASan/UBSan run. Real kernel ci-3d730e2e38ded1afdebb compiled by lowering private lib-buftable 614e9b56; package f0fb3fa4978b2f543109d181bec0dc5baf340275cbcaf0985110edf5efb4a589, 11 manifests, w19=0x700; FAU pointer/records/spans/retained-write verified through real bridge/fake JM. result v2-out/result.json. Cargo 30/30; rebuilt worker cdylib 43b87524868ada134ef9a360f0ef9bb2795bbc9d289e8c00bc1a4ba4e92a3aae from f9db0bf.

HASHES: test adcec4ea27b1bd652df9e2cd51456878ee1e14cec673a7bc1b578e3a7dbd3c70; runner 169510f590431815d2a97bab56aaba82f8160c879bef37515414da3e7ebc6fa1.

GAPS: no hardware/native; shared compiler must be rebuilt by lowering from ce462be8; existing N2C_JOB_BOS32 handle cap remains (table consumes no handle; >32 unique resources still transport-limited). No phone/publish/commit. Root owns commit.
